prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
engine_stated_criteria: in your city and business category
answer_verbatim:
For a small business, **Otterly.AI** looks like a good starting point: it’s designed for affordable AI-visibility tracking and monitors ChatGPT alongside other AI search services. Search results list plans around **$25–$29/month**, though pricing and included engines can change, so check its current plan details before subscribing.

If you mainly want to know whether ChatGPT recommends you **in your city and business category**, consider **Local Falcon** instead. It checks recommendations across locations in your market and offers a free starting allowance.

A free first step is **HubSpot’s AI Search Grader**, which gives a one-time snapshot rather than ongoing monitoring.

One caveat: these tools sample answers to selected prompts; they can’t guarantee what every person will see. Test realistic questions—such as “best [your service] in [your city]”—and track whether you’re named, which competitors appear, and what sources the AI cites.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
